lede: The item worth your attention this week is San Miguel County's Planning Commission meeting on September 10th, where three Land Use Code amendments — covering forestry practices, oil and gas, and geothermal energy — are up for the Commission's recommendation before moving to the BOCC. Also on the 10th, SMART's board votes on hiring an investment advisor and accepting the FY25 audit. Later in the week, the Housing Code Update working group holds its eighth session on September 15th, focused on removing Land Use Code barriers to workforce and affordable housing in unincorporated county.
